blocks.text: AAA for fixed and mobile broadband, Wi-Fi included. **RADIUS and Diameter** in one carrier-grade platform, with policy at the point of login.
Central control of who logs into every network device, from core routers to firewalls, and a record of every command they run.
Move mobile data and voice onto **carrier Wi-Fi** where radio coverage ends, with automatic SIM login and no app to install.
One trusted record of every subscriber's identity and profile. **HSS for 4G and IMS**.
Fiber and cable, Wi-Fi and mobile subscribers authenticate through the same platform. Plans, policies and usage stay consistent wherever the subscriber connects.

items: **Fixed broadband:** PPPoE and IPoE sessions from BNG and BRAS
**Wi-Fi:** SIM-based and portal logins from Wi-Fi controllers
**Mobile:** Diameter signaling from the packet core
**Network devices:** TACACS+ logins from network devices, routers to firewalls

sections.h2: Built for the access network you run next

items: Cloud native: on Kubernetes, in your environment
**Open:** standard protocols and APIs that work with your existing network equipment
**AI Agent Assist (beta):** answers connection and device-access questions in the AAA and TACACS+ consoles

items.q: What does AAA mean in telecom?
items.a: AAA stands for authentication, authorization and accounting. It confirms who a subscriber is, decides what they may use, and records what they used for billing.

items.q: What is the difference between RADIUS and TACACS+?
items.a: RADIUS controls subscriber access to the network. TACACS+ controls engineer access to network devices, down to each command.

items.q: Can you start with one product?
items.a: Yes. Each product runs on its own or alongside the systems you already have. Most operators start with one.
